sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module aims to expand students’ practical experience via lab sessions in analyzing real-world financial data using econometric techniques and models. The module further develops students’ mathematical, quantitative, programming and statistical skills as required for the study of accounting, finance and economics as well as industry careers.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Understand and apply basic Econometrics models in analyzing real-world financial data via software B Estimate and interpret the results arising from a range of regression models using software C Conduct hypothesis testing and use the results to inform decision making
sections.Method of teaching and learning: This module will be delivered using a combination of lectures, computer labs and self-directed study. The lectures are intended to provide conceptual details and empirical application to the topics. This will be built upon by completion of structured lectures and practical experience using econometric models in the lab sessions.
